1.0.15.en: Fix Logic variable mirroring via Manager API so charge_now and other variables stay in sync with the device.
1.0.15.da: Ret Logic-variabel spejling via Manager API, så charge_now og andre variabler følger enheden.

1.0.14.en: Night charging toggle, reliable 15-minute scheduler with quarter-hour alignment, and device UI sliders/toggles.
1.0.14.da: Natteopladning-toggle, pålidelig 15-minutters scheduler med kvarters-justering, og device UI med sliders/toggles.

1.0.13.en: Add configurable day/night charge windows, pairing guide in settings, and driver pairing fixes.
1.0.13.da: Tilføj konfigurerbare dag/nat-ladevinduer, pairing-vejledning i indstillinger og driver-rettelser.

1.0.2.en: Auto-create EV Ladeplan device on startup; add create-device button in settings.
1.0.2.da: Auto-opret EV Ladeplan-enhed ved opstart; tilføj knap i indstillinger.

1.0.3.en: EV charger tile: power toggle, measure_power status (W), and evcharger class.
1.0.3.da: EV-lader flise: power-knap, measure_power status (W), og evcharger-klasse.

1.0.6.en: Fix device.js syntax error and improve EV Ladeplan device discovery/provisioning.
1.0.6.da: Ret syntaxfejl i device.js og forbedret EV Ladeplan device-discovery/provisioning.

1.0.5.en: Direct Easee charger control from charge_now, with optional real power sync to the planner tile.
1.0.5.da: Direkte Easee-styring fra charge_now, med valgfri synkronisering af rigtig effekt til ladeplan-flisen.

1.0.4.en: Fix one-shot charge: freeze plan for single run, reset Logic variable, and fix false 11 kW display.
1.0.4.da: Ret engangsopladning: fast plan kun én gang, nulstil Logic-variabel, og ret forkert 11 kW visning.
